# Easy Graphs Charts and TikZ guides

79 step-by-step guides (335 steps) for Easy Graphs Charts and TikZ. Every picture is a screenshot of the plugin running in Obsidian, every step shows the lines it adds to the chart, and every guide ends with its finished chart as a block you can paste into a note.

The same guides are in the editor: open the Help tab. There each step shows a live chart with its sliders, the chart in words, and a button that loads the step into the editor.
